traits.name: Blood Frenzy.
traits.text: The sahuagin has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its HP.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness.
traits.text: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy.
traits.text: The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 ft., using a limited telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The sahuagin makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
